messages:
Elaine Chen: heads up — putting together a consolidated proposal for Console/Observability priorities next quarter. 3 pillars I'm pushing: 1) Reasonable retention/cost controls, 2) Traces + logs correlation, 3) Customer-facing dashboard templates for ML infra. Need quick reality check before the roadmap sync.
Vikram Rao: +1 on the pillars. main tradeoff is retention vs query latency. customers want 90d for audits, infra team says cost blowout.
Jordan M: for dashboards, can we prioritize a guided 'ML inference health' template (latency, tail latency, token cost per request)? that's a big ask from two customers.
SRE_Jen: we need a firm sampling story. either per-route 100% for a small set of routes + adaptive sampling elsewhere, or we blow GPU memory on traces.
Elaine Chen: thinking launch criteria: (a) policy-driven retention UI, (b) basic trace-log join view (no flamegraphs), (c) 2 customer templates + docs. Anything else?
Arnaud: add export-to-SIEM as stretch. legal customers already asking for Splunk/QRadar output. doesn't need to ship v1 but should be in spec.
Vikram Rao: cost estimate note: enabling 90d full traces for all customers = ~3.2x storage in our projections. if we do 30d + cold-tier 60d with sampled traces, cost delta ~1.4x.
SRE_Jen: propose this sampling config as a start:
```
sampling:
  routes:
    - name: high_priority_routes
      sample: 100
    - name: default
      sample: 5
adaptive_cache:
  kv_prefix: on
```
Elaine Chen: that config looks reasonable. we can present two options in the sync: "Compliance tier" (30d hot + 60d cold + export) vs "Default" (14d hot + sampling). want to align on which we recommend.
Jordan M: recommendation: default -> 14d hot sampled, compliance -> paid add-on 90d cold + export. keeps hosted pricing clean.
Arnaud: agree. also call out residency: for EU-only customers, cold-tier needs to be in-region. that's a separate cost bucket.
Vikram Rao: for tracing UX, we should ship a correlated traces+logs pivot first rather than full waterfall UI. much faster deliverable and hits the main customer ask.
SRE_Jen: +1. also flag: synthetic coverage tests for top 20 routes must be in CI before rollout to Dedicated. reduces regressions in ingest.
Elaine Chen: action items: @Vikram to draft cost model with two scenarios by EOD Tue; @Jordan to draft two dashboard templates + screenshots by Thu; @SRE_Jen to add synthetic tests checklist and sampling config to RFC. I'll own the launch criteria doc and customer messaging.
ops-bot: Reminder: roadmap-sync meeting scheduled Wed 10:00am PT (calendar invite sent).
Jordan M: one more thing — we should include a small OOB alert: "quality-regression" when model eval score drops >5% tied to a metric on Console. customers asked for it.
Elaine Chen: noted. will add as optional alerting policy (OKR tie: reduce MTTD for regressions by 40%).
Vikram Rao: last call — any constraints that would force us to remove traces+logs pivot from v1? storage only if we keep sample rates sane. otherwise dev effort is modest.
SRE_Jen: no blockers from infra if sampling + cold-tier plan exists. timeline: pivot v1 in 3 sprints, sampling + policies in 2 sprints.
Elaine Chen: perfect. I'll fold this into the sync deck and propose the two-tier recommendation. thanks all :raised_hands:
